data.label: November 2026

paragraphs.text: Two retrogrades end a day apart this month, Mercury on November 13 and Venus on November 14, and for you they end in adjacent rooms. The month opens quietly: on November 4 Venus at 24.7° Libra sextiles Jupiter at 24.7° Leo, an easy line between your solar eighth house of shared money and the sixth house of work and the body. The new moon on November 9 at 16.9° Scorpio falls in the ninth, the house of the long view: study, distance, belief, the subject you keep meaning to take seriously. It asks about scope, not logistics.

The stations are the real event. Mercury turns direct at 5.0° Scorpio and the ninth-house question stops circling. Venus turns direct at 22.9° Libra, so the shared-money conversation resumes a day behind it. Both have been in review together; they come out of it together. On November 16 Mars meets Jupiter at 25.9° Leo, both of them in that sixth house of work, exercise and daily order. The Sun at 26.1° Scorpio squares Jupiter at 26.1° Leo on November 18: the wide frame and the day's workload pulling against each other.

The Sun enters Sagittarius on November 22 and the top of your chart opens for a month. On November 24 it trines Neptune at 1.7° Aries, your ruler sitting in your house of earnings, and the full moon at 2.3° Gemini lights your fourth house of home the same day. Public life and private life both ask at once. November 25 crowds in behind that: the Sun sextile Pluto at 3.5° Aquarius, the Sun opposite Uranus at 3.7° Gemini, and Mars into Virgo and your seventh house.

Three easy aspects close the month. Venus at 26.7° Libra sextiles Jupiter at 26.7° Leo again on November 28, Uranus trines Pluto at 3.5° Aquarius on November 29, and on November 30 the Sun trines Saturn at 8.0° Aries. Saturn in your second house, the Sun at the top of the chart: a plain look at what the work is actually worth.

sky.line: New Moon in Scorpio on Mon 9 Nov, in your ninth solar house, travel, learning, beliefs, and long-term plans: a clean line to start something.
Mercury turns direct in Scorpio on Fri 13 Nov, in your ninth solar house, travel, learning, beliefs, and long-term plans: forward motion returns there.
Venus turns direct in Libra on Fri 13 Nov, in your eighth solar house, shared finances, debts, intimacy, and trust: forward motion returns there.
Sun enters Sagittarius on Sun 22 Nov, moving into your tenth solar house, career, reputation, and public responsibilities.
Full Moon in Gemini on Tue 24 Nov, in your fourth solar house, home, family, and your private life: something comes due.
Mars enters Virgo on Wed 25 Nov, moving into your seventh solar house, partners and one-to-one relationships.
